descriptions.inProgress: I'd better hurry and bring this orgel to Kyrin who is onboard on The Nautilus waiting for me, especially for Athena Pierce's sake who is dying to see Kyrin. Anyhow, it's amazing how deeply their fates are intertwined...
descriptions.completed: I've delivered the orgel to Kyrin per Athena Pierce's request. Kyrin seemed so happy- I guess it was a good thing that I picked up the letter from the trash after all?
